content: A single sincere tear washes away years of accumulated dust from the spirit.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Namida wa kokoro no ase — Folk Wisdom
explanation: Armoring yourself in stoic numbness causes the soul to calcify. Tears are not an admission of defeat; they are the spiritual sweat of emotional honesty. Allowing grief its natural expression rinses the windows of perception so clarity can return.
practicalInsight: Do not suppress tears or sorrow when they arrive. Welcome them as an honest, cleansing rain that prepares the soil for new growth.
reflectionPrompt: What grief or vulnerability have you been keeping locked behind a brittle wall of false toughness?
